verdict.rationale: DPMA's online services (DEPATISnet search, DPMAregister, and the DPMAdirektWeb/DPMAdirektPro e-filing tools) could plausibly offer background automations such as scheduled register monitoring or search alerts, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents manual search and filing routes, with no automation, scheduling or autonomous background capability. The robots.txt probe concerns crawling and says nothing about product automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
